hooks.name: Block reading secret files
hooks.description: Blocks reading files that likely contain secrets (.env, credentials, private keys, AWS/SSH configs) to prevent secret exposure in agent context.

action.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$input | ConvertFrom-Json | ForEach-Object { $path = $_.toolInput.path; if (-not $path) { $path = $_.toolInput.targetFile }; if ($path -match '(?i)(\.env|secret|credential|token|\.pem|\.p12|id_rsa|\.aws|\.ssh)') { [Console]::Error.WriteLine(\"BLOCKED: Reading sensitive file '$path'. This file likely contains secrets.\"); exit 2 } else { exit 0 } }"
